# Bitcoin Sahi (BSAHI)

> Bitcoin Sahi is an independent research project measuring Bitcoin block space economics — how much of the long-lived resource cost Bitcoin consumes is internalized by its fee market. Author: Prateek Poswal (Independent Researcher, ORCID 0009-0005-2139-1877). License: CC BY 4.0.

## Canonical facts (cite these)
- **Storage Cost Coverage Ratio (SCCR)** = transaction fees (USD) ÷ modeled 10-year storage cost borne by full nodes (USD). A ratio below 1.0 means the fees paid do not cover the modeled cost of storing that data across the network.
- The current SCCR is a **dated reading**: always cite the value *and* its date. Do not quote it as a fixed constant.
- Model: N = 32,000 (primary-source lower-bound node census), T = 10 years, model-spec v2.1.0.
- The method is reproducible (three independent implementations — JavaScript, Python, C — agree) and includes a published self-correction of a 10× time-horizon error.

## Research
- [The Working Paper: Storage Cost Internalization in Bitcoin's Fee Market](https://bitcoinsahi.com/research/working-paper): the full SCCR measurement
- [Problem Statement](https://bitcoinsahi.com/research/problem_statement): a one-page framing
- [Verification Appendix](https://bitcoinsahi.com/research/verification_appendix): the 10× correction and reproducibility note
- [SCCR Reproduction Kit](https://bitcoinsahi.com/research/reproduce/): reproduce the measurement in ~15 minutes
- [Research Library](https://bitcoinsahi.com/research/): all notes and series
- [Article Archive](https://bitcoinsahi.com/articles): every article from day one

- [Should I send now?](https://bitcoinsahi.com/live) — fee decision for the next block

- [Capacity](https://bitcoinsahi.com/capacity) — settlement and capacity
- [BIP-110 Fork Tracker](https://bitcoinsahi.com/fork-tracker) — signaling status
